sentences.en: That's why they allow students in college to have undeclared majors.

sentences.en: While their companies were losing undeclared billions, high executives were rewarding themselves with kings ' ransoms in salaries, options and bonuses.

sentences.en: Rogen was then cast in Apatow's followup TV comedy, Undeclared (2001), which focused on the lives of freshmen college students.

sentences.en: After writing for the series Undeclared, Rogen wrote for the second and final season of Da Ali G Show, starring Sacha Baron Cohen.
sentences.vi: Sau khi viết cho loạt phim Undeclared, Rogen đã viết cho phần thứ hai và phần cuối cùng của Da Ali G Show, với sự tham gia của Sacha Baron Cohen.

sentences.en: Forensic accounting in fact probably first came to public awareness during the O.J. Simpson civic trial when the plaintiffs used forensic accountants to search for undeclared assets.

sentences.en: Self employed individuals tend to be targets for audits more so than those earning wages from an employer since there is a greater possibility of undeclared income, so you will want to be especially careful.
